story: Auto-saving CSS And JavaScript Changes Locally From The Chrome Developer Tools
text: Yes. You can edit CSS in Resources panel ( [VIDEO] ) and JS in both Resources and Scripts panels. It doesn't have any code completion yet. Also, you have to double click to enter edit mode (I don't know why [LINK] ).
